institution: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M), GREMA - Madrid, Spain
details: PhD researcher since 12/2022; RF/microwave hardware and antenna systems for space, TT&C, and Earth observation.
SiGe BiCMOS on-chip antennas and RF front-ends above 100 GHz, extending beyond 200 GHz.
RF validation with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, probe stations, frequency extenders, chambers, and planar near-field setups.
Conducted a fully funded research stay on millimeter-wave, THz, and optical systems for biomedical and space applications in an international research environment.
